# Browser import dependencies

Self-hosted copies; no CDN requests.

- UTIF.js 3.1.0 — MIT — https://github.com/photopea/UTIF.js
- pako 1.0.11 — MIT/Zlib — https://github.com/nodeca/pako
- JSZip 3.10.1 — MIT (dual licensed MIT/GPLv3) — https://github.com/Stuk/jszip

Adjacent LICENSE files preserve the upstream notices. TIFF support is restricted by src/research_image.js because the decoder permissively accepts some unsupported formats. Original source pixels and coordinates are never replaced by display previews in exported project files.
